title: Caution against Unregistered Entities offering Virtual / Algo / Copy Trading
publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
summary: SEBI cautioned retail investors against unregistered platforms and entities offering automated algorithmic or copy-trading strategies promising high or guaranteed returns.

title: Advisory on Fraudulent Schemes claiming Institutional / FII / Foreign Quota Allotment
publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
summary: SEBI issued public warning regarding fraudsters luring individuals through social media channels into fake trading portals falsely claiming institutional / FII sub-account access.

title: Chakshu Portal Advisory on WhatsApp and Telegram Investment Fraud Groups
summary: DoT alerted citizens against unsolicited messages on messaging apps inviting users to private VIP channels for stock advice and task-based financial doubling schemes.
